dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL-NOS), diagnosed by excisional left cervical lymph node biopsy on 2026-09-09. The immunophenotype is non-germinal-center B-cell-like by the Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: DLBCL-NOS with an activated B-cell-like/non-GCB phenotype and double expression of BCL2 and MYC by immunohistochemistry.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage III, bulky, with B symptoms.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: The spleen is a lymphatic organ in the Lugano system, so splenic involvement remains stage III rather than IV

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: He has bulky stage III disease with B symptoms (fevers, drenching night sweats, and 7-kg weight loss).

mn_stage_iv.quote: splenic involvement remains stage III rather than IV

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: Standard IPI is 3 (age over 60, stage III, elevated LDH; ECOG 1 and no extranodal sites)

mol_de_not_dh.quote: FISH shows no MYC, BCL2, or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is a double-expressor DLBCL, not a double-hit/high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: this does not meet criteria for high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangements (double-hit/triple-hit)

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: double expression of BCL2 and MYC by immunohistochemistry

prog_ipi_3.quote: Standard IPI is 3 (age over 60, stage III, elevated LDH; ECOG 1 and no extranodal sites), which is high-intermediate risk

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI 3 (age over 60, stage III, elevated LDH; ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site, and no kidney/adrenal involvement), which is a high-risk category

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: I recommend 6 cycles of R-CHOP21 given with curative intent: rituximab 375 mg/m2, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2, vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 (capped at 2 mg)

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Pola-R-CHP is an NCCN category 1 alternative with a progression-free-survival advantage in advanced-stage DLBCL, but I am choosing R-CHOP as the default

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: if there is PET-positive residual bulky disease, I would biopsy it and consider involved-site radiation or second-line therapy.

mn_non_curative.quote: I recommend 6 cycles of R-CHOP21 given with curative intent

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R because the FISH-negative double-expressor phenotype is not double-hit/high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I would not reduce dose intensity at the outset. If he develops severe toxicity or becomes frail, I would consider dose modification or R-mini-CHOP.

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: HBV: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir) for prophylaxis because anti-HBc is positive, continue for at least 12 months after rituximab, and monitor HBV DNA.

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Before cycle 1 I still need: baseline HBV DNA and initiation of HBV antiviral prophylaxis

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: HBV: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir) for prophylaxis because anti-HBc is positive

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: which is a high-risk category, but he has none of the highest-risk CNS sites (testis, kidney/adrenal, paraspinal, bone marrow, breast) and no neurologic symptoms. I will perform a baseline lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: if negative, I will not give routine intrathecal methotrexate prophylaxis because the absolute benefit is uncertain and the risk of neurotoxicity is real.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Response will be assessed with an end-of-treatment FDG PET-CT from skull base to mid-thigh approximately 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted by Lugano/Deauville criteria.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 indicates residual disease and should prompt biopsy of the residual site if feasible, followed by involved-site radiation or second-line therapy.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis: allopurinol 300 mg daily (renal-adjusted) before cycle 1, hydration at 2-3 L/m2/day as tolerated, and frequent monitoring of urate, potassium, phosphate, calcium, and creatinine

sup_gcsf.quote: Febrile neutropenia: pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 2 of each cycle

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative-intent therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, fully independent, working part-time from home, no cardiac, pulmonary, renal, or hepatic disease, LVEF 58%, eGFR 96

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Baseline HBV DNA level and confirmation that HBV antiviral prophylaxis has been started.
